example.says: Invented numbers · no run of Cells' engine

model.label: GARD assembly
model.plain: An assembly of fat-like molecules that grows by taking molecules in, splits in two, and may pass its mix of molecules to its daughters: the Graded Autocatalysis Replication Domain model.

time.nominal: The rate constants carry no calibrated unit: the clock counts fissions, and a fission's nominal time is the model's own.

catalysis.says: beta_ij: how much a molecule of type j in the assembly speeds the joining and the leaving of type i

reservoir.says: every type held at the same concentration, never running down

law.name: the preprint's single-event form
law.says: The catalytic boost is taken at the assembly as it stands, for a join and a leave alike, as the preprint states it (its appendix F).

rules.start: 40 molecules of 40 types, drawn uniformly without replacement
rules.events: one molecule joins or leaves at a time, chosen in proportion to every rate
rules.split: an exact half, drawn without replacement, to the first daughter

trace.encoding: signed type numbers, one for each molecule: +(i + 1) when type i joins, -(i + 1) when it leaves

analysis.by: the example tool itself: worked out with the numbers, which are invented, so that the view has an analysis to read

inheritance.compares: the parent just before a fission with the daughter that carries on
inheritance.says: Inherited where H is above 0.9; at 0.9 or below, a break (the Plastic Heredity preprint's definition).

analysis.composomes_note: No clustering was run: the example names no composome.
